Training centres · private schools · in French

School timetable

For training centres and small private schools that build their timetable in a spreadsheet. Groups (head count only, no learner names), trainers with their availability and annual quota, rooms with capacity and equipment, modules with their planned hours. Sessions are placed by hand on a weekly grid with your own time slots; clashes are flagged at once: trainer, room or group booked twice, room too small, missing equipment, trainer unavailable, closed day, planned hours exceeded. Views by group, trainer and room, A/B weeks, French public holidays calculated, a week copied to the following ones in one step, A4 landscape print and CSV export. No automatic scheduling.
